title: Health status
description: The plugin's own view of its condition. Used both as the result of `getHealth` and as the payload of `plugin.health.<component>` pushes — one definition, two references, so a poll and a push can never disagree about shape.

status.title: Overall condition
status.description:
`ok` — operating normally.
`degraded` — still serving, but something is wrong: upstream is flaky, pushes are being dropped, a subset of devices is unreachable.
`failing` — not serving. The core may restart the plugin.

counters.title: Component counters
counters.description: Free-form numeric gauges — peers, open sessions, dropped pushes, queue depth. Surfaced in the UI and useful in a bug report; nothing branches on them.
